name: Class buffs: the Elune's Grace and Faith armor cooldowns stack on one ally
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 (PR #13237 review): a buff of five minutes or longer keeps one per stat
across classes; a shorter buff whose tooltip says it does not stack with similar effects is a support buff
and keeps one per stat among support buffs; every other shorter buff is a cooldown, has no CoA class
category and stacks with everything. Elune's Grace 504027 (Starcaller, class 26, 15 seconds) and Faith
804405 (Sun Cleric, class 27, 20 seconds) both give SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT physical, base points 9:
+10% armor, to one ally. Both are cooldowns, so no spell_group decides the pair. Expected: on a grouped
ally Faith leaves Elune's Grace in place.

steps.label: SETUP: the ally carries Elune's Grace
Elune's Grace applies its DBC amount
Give a replacement time to remove Elune's Grace
DISCRIMINATING: Faith leaves Elune's Grace in place
DISCRIMINATING: Elune's Grace leaves Faith in place
